overall_goal: Tear the lettuce into individual leaves, wash them in the sink, and squeeze them dry.

goals.description: Open the lettuce packaging and prepare the chopping board.
goals.rationale: The person opens the plastic packet, removes the heads of lettuce, and positions the chopping board for use.

goals.description: Tear the first head of lettuce into individual leaves.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly tears leaves off the first head of lettuce and places them on the chopping board, eventually discarding the core.

goals.description: Tear the second head of lettuce into individual leaves.
goals.rationale: The person picks up the second head of lettuce, tears off its leaves onto the chopping board, and discards the core.

goals.description: Transfer the torn lettuce leaves to the colander in the sink.
goals.rationale: The person scoops up the pile of torn lettuce leaves and carries them to the sink, placing them into a colander.

goals.description: Wash and rinse the lettuce leaves under running water.
goals.rationale: The person turns on the tap and manipulates the colander and leaves under the running water to rinse away dirt.

goals.description: Drain, squeeze, and shake the lettuce leaves to remove excess water.
goals.rationale: The person squeezes and shakes the lettuce leaves and the colander to dry them, then returns the colander to the counter.
